finding.claim: renameFile() never applies checkFilename or the dangerous-extension denylist to the target name, so an editor can rename an uploaded .txt to .html in a page media folder and serve it inline as text/html on the site origin (stored XSS).
finding.source: Editor with media-edit rights uploads x.txt (allowed by system/config/media.yaml:99-102); calls renameFile('x.txt','x.html') (entry is an out-of-tree admin/API caller).
finding.sink: MediaUploadTrait.php:499 rename() via doRename (474-513); rendered by system/src/Grav/Common/Grav.php:875-910 Utils::download inline.

trace.note: target basename/ext taken without checkFilename or media-type check
rename() performed; only is_file overwrite check at 494

finding.guards_checked: checkFilename (Utils.php:1022-1039) not called on rename; uploads_dangerous_extensions (system/config/security.yaml:61-83) not applied; sanitize_svg and FormFlashFile::checkXss only on upload path; render-time XSS scan not applied to files; doRename only blocks overwrite. Reachability caveat: renameFile has no caller in this tree.

finding.claim: deleteFile() validates only the basename but builds the unlink path from the full caller-supplied name, so ../ segments delete arbitrary files outside the media folder (any file with a non-dangerous extension).
finding.source: Caller-supplied filename: FlexMediaTrait::deleteMediaFile(string $filename) (FlexMediaTrait.php:292-301) or a Flex save 'files' payload whose delete keys are stored raw (FlexMediaTrait.php:386-424, saved at 490-499).

trace.note: pathname taken from full filename, containing ../

finding.guards_checked: checkFilename on basename only (340); Filesystem::getInstance(false) is unnormalized (Filesystem.php:40-48,160-171); AbstractMedia::fileExists (275-278) has no containment; denylisted extensions (.yaml, .php, .md) are blocked by checkFilename, so impact is limited to non-denylisted types.

finding.claim: xml is missing from uploads_dangerous_extensions while media.yaml maps it to application/xml and serves it inline, so an uploaded XHTML-namespace XML file can run script on the site origin (stored XSS).
finding.source: Upload by a user with upload rights (MediaUploadTrait::checkUploadedFile 74-108, checkFileMetadata 118-237).
finding.sink: Inline serving via Grav.php:875-910 and Utils.php:713-724 with Content-Type application/xml.

trace.note: xml mapped to application/xml, allowed as media type

finding.guards_checked: checkXss runs only for svg (FormFlashFile.php:191-201); xml not in denylist; no content sanitizer for xml. Browser script execution in XML documents is browser-dependent and was not verified in a browser.

finding.claim: deleteRows() does not validate the storage key (saveRow does via assertValidKey), so a traversal key can make hasKey/getPathFromKey resolve outside the storage root and trigger file deletion plus a recursive folder delete.
finding.source: Flex delete request key (out-of-tree API caller).
finding.sink: FolderStorage.php:189 deleteFile and :196 deleteFolder($storagePath, true) recursive.

trace.note: getObjectMeta uses is_file on traversal path

finding.guards_checked: saveRow assertValidKey (FolderStorage.php:422-423) and validateKey (AbstractFilesystemStorage.php:221-244) are not applied on the delete path. Impact depends on each Flex type's dataPattern, which was not verified for all types. Verdict PLAUSIBLE.
